items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: one of them turned out to be a very good friend of mine, Bob Manners

ctx.x: So you had yourself and piano and a drummer?

I think so, yes, at that time. Actually I’m trying to remember the timeline there. Because for a while there I had a little group, I must have been quite a bit beyond that, where I had the trio. We have a cooperative quartet: jazz accordion, a great jazz accordion player, Pete Sacaponti, and a guitar and a bass. And there were three or four others of the same combination at the same time. As a matter of fact there’s an article, I should have brought that, I only found this one but I know it’s home somewhere,…
So by the time you were in your late teens, had you decided that I’m going to be a musician. This is my career.
